headline: Mooring and Farranac See Renewed Base Fighting
war_summary: Since the previous edition, MooringCountyHex has plainly taken the lead in base activity, with 23 events in twenty-four hours, 14 in six hours and five in the latest two; its twelve strategic bases remain divided nine to three between Wardens and Colonials. FarranacCoastHex has also stirred, recording twelve daily events and three in the latest two hours, including activity at Transient Valley, while all eleven bases currently stand Colonial. StlicanShelfHex has advanced from three reported events to five, with two in the latest two hours around Fort Hoarfrost and a close five-to-four split favoring the Wardens. WeatheredExpanseHex remains the largest rolling contest by casualty volume and has 32 daily base events, though none in the latest two hours; its ownership is six Warden bases to three Colonial. StonecradleHex retains seventeen daily events but has gone quiet in the latest six hours, with eight Colonial bases, one Warden base, and ongoing historical turnover at World's End and The Reach. Callahans Passage shows no recorded base events, yet its casualty and enlistment rates are accelerating sharply, marking it as a front worth watching.
